nodes.label: You can enter emoji, any text, or Unicode symbols here. Drag an item from the palette onto a key to assign it.

Opened by the app:showEmojiMenuN actions, where N is the page position: reordering pages changes which page a key opens. Each cell can hold an emoji, a UTF symbol (e.g. ≠), any other character (e.g. №), or a short phrase (e.g. "// TODO: ").

In the popup, click a cell or press its key: the cells follow the keyboard rows Q–T, A–G and Z–B. Tab switches pages; digits open a page by its number.
